details: A hollow star can use only coordinates in the effective range.
proof: If a projected class contains a hollow $d$-star on S, then for each $x\in S$ the star's realizable neighbours include labelings that differ at x.  Thus every x in S lies in the effective range, so $d\le \mathrm E(\mathcal H)$.  Maximizing d gives $\mathrm{coVC}(\mathcal H)\le\mathrm E(\mathcal H)$.
name: Effective Range / co-VC Dimension
